description: Source code for a utility that fixes MD5 checksums in WRGG headers on MTD devices, including functions for reading, verifying, and rewriting headers.

methods.name: le32_to_cpu
methods.description: Converts a 4-byte little-endian buffer to a 32-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: wrgg_fix_md5
methods.description: Recalculates and updates the MD5 checksum in a WRGG header.

methods.name: mtd_fixwrgg
methods.description: Fixes the WRGG header in an MTD device at a specified offset.
